```{=html}

<div id="break-slide-BREAKID" style="
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(220px, 0.85fr);
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5vw;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 0 6vw;
  color: white;
  font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
">

  <!-- LEFT PANE: replace this fun fact, short story, anecdote, or image with a week-specific item -->
  <div style="max-width: 620px;">

      margin-bottom: 0.8em;

    ">While you pause</div>

    <div style="
      margin-top: 1.2em;
      color: #cccccc;
      font-size: 0.95em;
      line-height: 1.55;
      font-style: italic;
    ">
      <!-- TODO: insert a fun fact, short story, anecdote, or image relevant to this week -->
      [Insert a week-specific fun fact, short story, anecdote, or image here.]
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- RIGHT PANE: timer -->
  <div style="
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
  ">
    <svg class="break-timer-svg" width="180" height="180" viewBox="0 0 180 180">
      <circle cx="90" cy="90" r="75"
        fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="14"/>
      <circle id="donut-ring-BREAKID" cx="90" cy="90" r="75"
        fill="none" stroke="#EF7C00" stroke-width="14"
        stroke-dasharray="471.24" stroke-dashoffset="0"
        stroke-linecap="round"
        transform="rotate(-90 90 90)"/>
      <text id="timer-text-BREAKID" x="90" y="98"
        text-anchor="middle"
        font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif"
        font-size="32" font-weight="bold"
        fill="white">05:00</text>
    </svg>
    <span id="timer-status-BREAKID" role="timer" aria-live="polite" style="
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: -1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
      white-space: nowrap;
      border: 0;
    ">05:00</span>

    <button id="break-btn-BREAKID" type="button" style="
      margin-top: 1.2em;
      padding: 0.5em 2em;
      font-size: 1em;
      font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
      background: #EF7C00;

      border: none;
      border-radius: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    ">▶ Start Timer</button>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
(function() {
  var TOTAL = 5 * 60; // Change minutes here if needed.

  function createCountdownTimer(options) {
    var total = options.total;
    var remaining = total;
    var interval = null;
    var state = 'idle';
    var audioContext = null;
    var textEl = document.getElementById(options.textId);
    var statusEl = document.getElementById(options.statusId);
    var ringEl = document.getElementById(options.ringId);
    var buttonEl = document.getElementById(options.buttonId);
    var circumference = 2 * Math.PI * 75;
    var initialColour = ringEl.getAttribute('stroke');

    function pad(value) { return value < 10 ? '0' + value : '' + value; }
    function render(seconds) {
      var minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
      var remainder = seconds % 60;
      var display = pad(minutes) + ':' + pad(remainder);
      textEl.textContent = display;
      statusEl.textContent = state === 'complete' ? "Time's up!" : display;
      ringEl.setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', circumference * (1 - seconds / total));
    }
    function playTimerEndRing() {
      if (!audioContext) return;
      var oscillator = audioContext.createOscillator();
      var gain = audioContext.createGain();
      var now = audioContext.currentTime;
      oscillator.type = 'sine';
      oscillator.frequency.value = 880;
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18, now);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.5);
      oscillator.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(audioContext.destination);
      oscillator.start(now);
      oscillator.stop(now + 0.5);
    }
    function ensureAudio() {
      var AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (AudioContextClass && !audioContext) audioContext = new AudioContextClass();
      if (audioContext && audioContext.state === 'suspended') audioContext.resume();
    }
    function reset() {
      clearInterval(interval);
      interval = null;
      remaining = total;
      state = 'idle';
      ringEl.setAttribute('stroke', initialColour);
      buttonEl.textContent = '▶ Start Timer';
      buttonEl.disabled = false;
      render(remaining);
    }
    function tick() {
      remaining = Math.max(0, remaining - 1);
      render(remaining);
      if (remaining === 0) {
        clearInterval(interval);
        interval = null;
        state = 'complete';
        ringEl.setAttribute('stroke', '#00c875');
        buttonEl.textContent = '↻ Restart Timer';
        playTimerEndRing();
      }
    }
    function handleClick() {
      if (state === 'complete') { reset(); return; }
      if (state === 'running') {
        clearInterval(interval);
        interval = null;
        state = 'paused';
        buttonEl.textContent = '▶ Resume';
        return;
      }
      ensureAudio();
      state = 'running';
      buttonEl.textContent = '⏸ Pause';
      interval = setInterval(tick, 1000);
    }
    buttonEl.addEventListener('click', handleClick);
    render(remaining);
    return { reset: reset, pause: function() { if (state === 'running') handleClick(); } };
  }

  createCountdownTimer({
    total: TOTAL,
    textId: 'timer-text-BREAKID',
    statusId: 'timer-status-BREAKID',
    ringId: 'donut-ring-BREAKID',
    buttonId: 'break-btn-BREAKID'
  });
})();
</script>
```

::: notes
Break slide. Start the timer when you announce the break. The fun fact, short story, anecdote, or image is displayed automatically — no action needed.
:::
